{"id":1514300255,"question_id":2685,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737355684,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1514300255/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"First Completely Painted Row or Column","memory":"134 MB","code":"class Solution {\n    #define pii pair<int ,int>\npublic:\n    int firstCompleteIndex(vector<int>& arr, vector<vector<int>>& mat) {\n        int m=mat.size();\n        int n=mat[0].size();\n        \n        //Step-1: Create lookup for each value in matrix\n        vector<pii> lookup(m*n+1);//Stores x,y coordinate for each element in matrix\n        for(int i=0;i<m;++i)\n            for(int j=0;j<n;++j)\n                lookup[mat[i][j]]=make_pair(i,j);\n\n        //Step-2: Find earliest row or col painted\n        vector<int> row_count(m,0);\n        vector<int> col_count(n,0);\n\n        for(int i=0;i<m*n;++i){\n            pii coordinate = lookup[arr[i]];\n            int x = coordinate.first;\n            int y = coordinate.second;\n            \n            row_count[x]++;\n            col_count[y]++;\n            if(row_count[x]==n or col_count[y]==m)\n                return i;\n        }\n        return 0;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"first-completely-painted-row-or-column","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":208}
